title: Table 128. Document revision history
text_helper: Table 128. Document revision history — section 9 Important security notice. Date, Revision, Changes.

rows: Updated Table 40: ESD absolute maximum ratings adding packages. Updated note of Table 19: Typical and maximum current consumptions in Standby mode. Updated Figure 1: STM32F750V8 LQFP100 pinout replacing PB13 and PB14 by PE13 and PE14. Updated Table 38: EMS characteristics replacing 168 MHz by 216 MHz. Updated Section 3.9: Quad-SPI memory interface (QUADSPI) removing 'STM32F75xx'. Removed Table 86. Ethernet DC electrical characteristics. Updated all the notes removing 'not tested in production'. Updated Table 30: Main PLL characteristics, Table 31: PLLI2S characteristics and Table 32: PLLISAI characteristics fVCO_OUT output at min value '100' and VCO freq at 100 MHz. Updated Table 2: STM32F756xx register boundary addresses replacing cortex-M4 by Cortex-M7. Updated Table 74: Dynamics characteristics: Ethernet MAC signals for MII td (TXEN) and td (TXD) min value at 6.5 ns.

Updated Table 11: STM32F750x8 pin and ball definition additional function column: WKUP1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 must be respectively PA0, PA2, PC1, PC13, PI8, PI11. Updated Table 49: ADC characteristics adding V negative voltage REF- reference. Update Table 1: Voltage characteristics adding table note 3. Updated Table 56: Temperature sensor calibration values memory addresses. Updated Table 59: Internal reference voltage calibration values memory addresses.
